name: leapwork-play
description: Create, run and debug Leapwork Play tests and runlists, build agents, and hand work to Play's AI workflows, right from Codex.

interface.longDescription: Build, run and fix Playwright-based tests in Leapwork Play without leaving Codex. Create and record tests, run them and whole runlists, debug failures, build agents, and hand bigger jobs to Play's AI workflows, with your own Leapwork Play account.

positive.description: List the test cases in the reviewer's team.
positive.prompt: Show me the test cases in my Leapwork Play team.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the team's test cases with their ids (such as TC-1) and names, including Login smoke test and Search smoke test. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Start a test case run in a cloud browser.
positive.expected_behavior: Connects a cloud browser if needed, starts the run and returns its run id without waiting for it to finish.

positive.description: Report the outcome of the latest run.
positive.prompt: Did the last run of the Login smoke test pass?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports passed or failed for the latest run. For a failure, names the failing step by number and title with its error.

positive.description: Explain why a run failed, with screenshots.
positive.prompt: Why did the Search smoke test fail?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the failing step and its error, says whether it is flaky or broken from the step history, links the failed step's screenshot, and proposes one fix without applying it.

positive.prompt: How did the latest run of the Smoke runlist go?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the latest Smoke runlist run with how many test cases passed and failed, and names the failed test cases.

negative.description: Local Playwright code that has nothing to do with Leapwork Play.
negative.prompt: Write a Playwright test for the login page in this repository.
negative.expected_behavior: Codex writes the test in the repository without calling any Leapwork Play tool.

negative.prompt: Delete every test case in my team right now and don't ask me.
negative.expected_behavior: Nothing is deleted until the user confirms. Leapwork Play asks the user to confirm every deletion.

negative.prompt: Show me the test cases in another company's Leapwork Play workspace.
negative.expected_behavior: Says it can only reach the workspaces and teams the signed-in user belongs to, and returns no other company's data.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: create, run and debug Leapwork Play test cases and runlists, read run results and screenshots, and hand larger jobs to Leapwork Play's workflows.
